title: ServerMessage
description: Messages from the service to the client.

oneOf.description: Error; `request_id` absent if the frame was not decodable.
Close initiated by the service; the transport close follows.

Admission.description: Outcome of accepting a request (before forwarding).

duplicate.description: `true` if the request repeats an already known `operation_id` (no new effect).

AgentBaselineView.description: A baseline as seen by an agent session (no host details).

clean_shutdown.description: Created after an observed clean shutdown.

current.description: The VM's current state is an overlay of it.

initial.description: Initial baseline of the session (protected: never replaced by agents).

restorable.description: The session may restore it (initial or created by the session).

AgentDeclaration.description: Declaration of the agent at the end of its work: a claim, never an outcome.

AgentVmView.description: A VM as seen by an agent session (no host details).

geometry.description: Display geometry, if known (for pointer coordinates).

input_owner.description: `true` if this session owns the input of the VM.

BaselineId.description: BaselineId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

BaselineSummary.description: Baseline of a VM, for `list_baselines` and `create_baseline` (F3).

clean_shutdown.description:
`true` if created after an observed clean guest shutdown (or before
any run); `false` = **not verified**: created after a forced or
unobserved stop with explicit consent (`allow_unclean`).

current.description: The VM's current state is an overlay of this baseline.

derived_from.description:
Baseline the source state derived from (the VM was running on an
overlay of it when this baseline was created); `None` = created from
the standalone disk. Informational only: every baseline is a
standalone image (no backing chain).

disk_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the disk image, verified before every restore and start.

firmware_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UEFI variables, if the baseline has them.

in_use.description: In use (current overlay or an open run): `delete_baseline` is refused.

protected.description:
Protected baseline (initial baseline of an agent session, F4):
cannot be deleted.

size_bytes.description: Bytes on the host (disk image and UEFI variables).

host.description: Capacity of the host as measured by the backend, if available.

Capability.description:
Authorizable action on a VM. Serialized names follow the MCP catalog
(ROADMAP 9); `vm.input` covers mouse and keyboard.

oneOf.description: Checkpoint with the VM off: requires an explicit capability.
Authorized LightVM events and QEMU logs.

CloseReason.description: Reason the service closed the connection.

client_name.description: Name declared by the client, diagnostic only.

peer_pid.description: Peer PID reported by the operating system, diagnostic only.

ConsoleTicket.description:
Per-run display ticket for the console (ADR-0013, ROADMAP 6.4).

The UI connects to `socket_path` (a Unix socket in a directory private to
the user), writes `token` followed by `\n` and then speaks RFB. The
supervisor forwards the stream to QEMU's display only after checking the
token; the ticket is distinct from the QMP channel and from the IPC
credential, valid for one run, and revoked with it.

`Debug` redacts the token (it ends up in logs and panic messages).

run_id.description: Run the ticket is valid for.

token.description: Display credential in hexadecimal: never logged.

DetectedGuest.description:
Guest detected from the contents of an installation ISO at import
(ADR-0027). A hint for the wizard, never a guarantee: the user confirms
or corrects it, and nothing in the guest is trusted because of it.

arch.description: Detected architecture, if the medium says.

build.description:
Build number (for example 6002 for Vista SP2, 19045 for Windows 10
22H2), if the medium says.

edition.description: Edition or product name read from the medium (text, never interpreted).

DiskController.description:
Main disk controller of an imported VM (ADR-0030): the controller the
guest was installed on, so that its boot driver finds the disk.

oneOf.description: Parallel IDE (PIIX controller of the i440fx board).

DisplayAdapter.description: Display adapter of an imported VM (ADR-0030).

oneOf.description:
The adapter of the guest profile (ADR-0027: `VGA` for Windows,
`virtio-vga` for Linux).

VMware SVGA II (`vmware-svga`), for a Windows guest that has the
VMware Tools display driver.

EmergencyStopReport.description: Outcome of the Emergency Stop reported to the client.

completed.description: True only if the end of all processes was observed.

processes_terminated.description: Processes whose end the backend observed.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable code of an operational error. Serialized names never change;
new codes are only ever added.

oneOf.description:
Caller identified (valid credential) but not authorized for the action:
VM outside the allowlist, missing capability, paused session, insufficient
role. Missing or invalid credentials: [`ErrorCode::Unauthenticated`].
Session or lease expired: a new authorization in the app is needed.
Another mutation is in progress or queued on the same VM: retryable.
Capability not available on this host, build or phase.
The action is not allowed in the current state (or refers to a superseded `run_id`).
Resource, quota or size limit exceeded.
Invalid argument (format, range, name, rejected path).
Object does not exist or is not visible to the caller.
Infrastructure failure (QEMU, QMP, storage, OS) not attributable to the caller.

No valid credential: IPC credential or session token missing,
malformed, unknown, revoked or reused after a supervisor restart.
A new authorization in the app is needed. Appended after the first nine
codes, which remain unchanged.

Firmware.description:
Guest firmware. Linux guests use UEFI with managed NVRAM state (ROADMAP 8,
ADR-0011); legacy Windows guests use SeaBIOS, which has no NVRAM
(ADR-0027). [`GuestOs::allowed_firmware`] says which applies.

oneOf.description: Legacy BIOS (SeaBIOS from the verified QEMU build), no NVRAM.

Grant.description: Grant issued by the supervisor after the user's approval in the app (ROADMAP 9).

policy_revision.description: Revision of the policy the grant was issued with.

vm_allowlist.description: Allowed VMs (explicit allowlist; empty = no VM).

GrantId.description: GrantId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

GuestArch.description: Architecture of an installation medium, as detected from its contents.

GuestOs.description:
Declared guest operating system. In the MVP the reference is Ubuntu LTS
x86_64 with the version and checksum pinned in F0 (ROADMAP 4). The
Windows variants (ADR-0027, ROADMAP R2c) select a hardware profile with
devices the guest has inbox drivers for; they are manual, offline guests
and their compatibility cells stay "not verified" until real evidence.

oneOf.description: Other Linux x86_64: manageable manually, without compatibility guarantees.
Windows XP (NT 5.1, and XP x64 / NT 5.2): legacy BIOS, i440fx, PIIX IDE.
Windows Vista (NT 6.0): legacy BIOS, q35, AHCI.
Windows 8.1 (NT 6.3): UEFI (x64) or legacy BIOS (32-bit), q35, AHCI.

Windows 10 (NT 10.0, build < 22000): UEFI (x64) or legacy BIOS
(32-bit), q35, AHCI.

Windows 11 on ARM64 (build 22000 and later): macOS/HVF hosts only,
`virt`, UEFI with Secure Boot, TPM 2.0 (ADR-0028).

HostCapacity.description: Host capabilities detected by the probe (supplied to the core, never invented).

accelerator_available.description: Hardware accelerator available and approved (no TCG fallback: ADR-0007).

free_storage_gib.description: Free space on the catalog volume in GiB.

input_available.description: Typed input available in the backend.

reserved_memory_mib.description: Memory to leave to the host in MiB (reserve).

reserved_storage_gib.description: Space to leave free in GiB (reserve, ADR-0017).

screenshot_available.description: Screen capture available in the backend.

ImportSource.description: Where an imported VM came from (ADR-0030).

oneOf.description: VMware Workstation or Player (`.vmx` + VMDK), converted to QCOW2.

ImportWarning.description: Warning of a VMware import, in [`VmwareImportPreview`].

detail.description:
Values for the message (for example the VMware value and the one
LightVM uses), shown as text.

oneOf.description:
Windows on an LSI Logic parallel controller, which QEMU does not
emulate: Windows may not start (stop 0x7B) until the storage driver
of the new controller is enabled in the guest (manual preparation,
`docs/USER_GUIDE.md`).

A controller QEMU does not emulate on a Linux guest: the disk is
attached to the profile's controller (the initramfs must have its
driver, as standard distributions do).
The guest memory was raised to the minimum of the guest system.
The guest memory was lowered to the host limit.
The vCPUs were lowered to the host limit.
The VMware CPU topology could not be kept (one socket per vCPU).

VMware uses the same guest type for Windows 8 and 8.1: LightVM
supports 8.1 only.

UEFI guest: the firmware starts with a new variable store, so the
boot entries of VMware are not carried over (the default loader of
the disk is used).
A disk of the snapshot chain is marked dirty (not closed cleanly).

ImportedHardware.description:
Hardware of a VM imported from VMware (ADR-0030), in
[`VmConfig::imported`]. Fixed at import: a configuration change cannot
alter it.

arch.description: Architecture of the guest, from the VMware guest type.

cores_per_socket.description:
vCPUs per socket of the source VM (`cpuid.coresPerSocket`): client
editions of Windows use at most one or two sockets. `None` = one
socket per vCPU, as for VMs created in LightVM.

storage_driver_preparation.description:
The source disk was on a controller QEMU does not emulate (VMware
`lsilogic`) and the guest is Windows: the storage driver of
[`Self::disk_controller`] must be enabled for boot in the guest
before it can start from this disk (ADR-0030). The automatic offline
preparation is not available yet; the user prepares the guest in
VMware (`docs/USER_GUIDE.md`).

InputOwner.description: Owner of the input of a VM: the user or one agent session, never both.

Label.description: Text declared by the user, without control characters; never interpreted.

Lease.description:
Lease of a session: it must be renewed before it expires, otherwise the
session is revoked through the emergency path (ROADMAP 7.3).

at.description: Instant (for QEMU lines: the instant of the read).

seq.description: Sequence (report event `seq` for LightVM entries, line number for QEMU).

oneOf.description: QEMU diagnostics of the current run (host paths removed).

MediaId.description: MediaId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

MediaKind.description: Kind of media in the media registry.

oneOf.description: Read-only data ISO to bring the software under test into the guest (ADR-0008).

MediaRecord.description:
Approved media, as seen by clients. Sent only to the `ui` role
(`list_media`, `import_media`): agent sessions never receive it.

declared_origin.description: Origin declared by the user (text, never interpreted).

detected_guest.description:
Guest detected from the contents at import (installation ISOs only;
`None` = not recognized, data medium, or imported before detection).

location.description:
Where the ISO is, shown to the user (ADR-0029): absolute path of the
user's own file, used in place and never copied. `None` for a
read-only copy kept in the catalog (media imported before ADR-0029).
Informative text: no request carries it back.

missing.description:
The file was not found at [`Self::location`] the last time it was
looked for (moved, renamed, deleted, or its drive is not connected):
no VM can use the medium until the file is back there or the ISO is
imported again.

sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the file, computed at approval and re-verified before
every start.

size_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the file.

NetworkProfile.description:
Network profile. In the MVP the only allowed value is `offline` (ADR-0004): no
guest NIC, default network devices excluded, no forwarding.

NotImported.description: Part of a VMware VM that is not imported, in [`VmwareImportPreview`].

detail.description:
Detail from the `.vmx` (for example a file name or a count), shown
as text.

oneOf.description: Network adapters: LightVM VMs are offline (ADR-0004).
Shared folders: recreated later through LightVM Tools (ADR-0031).
USB controllers and devices: recreated later through LightVM Tools.
Intermediate snapshots (only the current state is converted).
A hard disk other than the main one.
A CD/DVD drive (an ISO can be imported as a data medium).

VMware Tools features (clipboard, drag and drop, time sync):
recreated later through LightVM Tools (ADR-0031).

OperationId.description: OperationId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

OperationKind.description: Kind of operation of the per-VM queue.

oneOf.description: Creation of the VM in the catalog.
Checkpoint with the VM off (from F3).
Restore of a baseline with the VM off (from F3).
Emergency Stop (priority path, outside the queue).

run_id.description: Run it refers to, if relevant.

updated_at.description: Instant of the last status change.

oneOf.description: Accepted, queued, not yet forwarded to the backend.
Forwarded to the backend: it may produce effects even after a revocation.
Discarded before forwarding (revocation, Emergency Stop, superseded `run_id`): no effect.

OutcomeSource.description: Where the current outcome of a report comes from.

oneOf.description: Live session: not decided yet (the outcome reads `inconclusive`).
Explicit judgement of the local user in the app.

ParentLossPolicy.description:
Fate of the VMs when the UI that started the service ends without a
controlled shutdown (crash, forced termination). ADR-0015 part B.

oneOf.description: Emergency Stop of all VMs, then shutdown of the service (default).

Orderly (ACPI) shutdown with a bounded wait, then `quit` and
termination; finally shutdown of the service.

powerdown_s.description:
Wait for the ACPI shutdown per VM, in seconds
([`MIN_PARENT_LOSS_POWERDOWN_S`]..=[`MAX_PARENT_LOSS_POWERDOWN_S`]).

oneOf.description: The VMs stay on and the service stays active without a UI.

PolicyRevision.description: Monotonic revision of the applied policy (recorded in reports, ROADMAP 9).

ProtocolError.description: Protocol error: distinct from operational errors (ROADMAP 9).

ProtocolErrorCode.description: Code of a protocol error (request not understood, no effect attempted).

oneOf.description: Message not decodable or not conforming to the schema.
Message exceeds the maximum allowed size.

Kept for contract compatibility but **not emitted**: a missing or invalid
credential produces the operational error [`ErrorCode::Unauthenticated`]
(see the module documentation).

PublicError.description:
Public operational error.

JSON shape: `{"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {..}?, "retryable": bool}`.

details.description: Optional structured details (textual keys and values, without secrets).

message.description: Message for humans, without secrets or host paths.

retryable.description: `true` if retrying the same idempotent request may succeed.

Quotas.description:
Quotas of a session or of a policy layer. Each field is an inclusive
maximum; the intersection takes the minimum.

max_input_events.description: Total input events allowed in the session.

max_operations.description: Total operations allowed in the session.

max_queued_operations.description: Operations queued per VM and not yet forwarded.

max_screenshot_bytes.description: Maximum size of a single screenshot in bytes.

max_screenshots.description: Total screenshots allowed in the session.

ReplyError.description:
Reply error: either operational or protocol, never mixed up.

JSON shape: `{"kind": "operational", ...PublicError}` or
`{"kind": "protocol", ...ProtocolError}`.

oneOf.description: Request understood but rejected or failed.
Request not understood: no effect attempted.

clean_shutdown.description: Created after an observed clean shutdown.

oneOf.description: Agent call seen by the service (refusals included).

error_code.description: Error code, if refused or failed.

oneOf.description: Tool note of the adapter (MCP tool name and a bounded summary).

detail.description: Bounded summary (never typed text: length and SHA-256 only).

error_code.description: Error code (operational or adapter), if any.

retained.description: Stored in the session artefacts (retention limits).

shot.description: Index among the screenshots of the report, from 0.

oneOf.description: State change of the session's VM.

ReportVersions.description: Versions of the components that served the session.

mcp_protocol.description: MCP protocol revision declared by the adapter, if any.

vm.description: Created VM, with identifier assigned by the core.

oneOf.description: Response to `update_vm`: VM with the new revision.
Response to `submit_vm`: acceptance and recorded outcome.

operation.description: Record of the operation after execution, if available.

oneOf.description: Pairing credential issued: it must be delivered out of band, never recorded.
UI loss policy in force after `set_parent_loss_policy`.

Response to `restore_baseline`: the VM's current state is now a new
overlay of the baseline.

verification_code.description: Code the user compares in the app.

oneOf.description:
Response to `await_session`: session approved and bound to this
connection.

sessions.description: Live sessions first, then the most recent terminated ones.

report.description: Discarded queue and requests already forwarded.

data.description: Bytes of the chunk, standard base64 with padding.

report.description: Discarded queue and requests already forwarded.

oneOf.description: A report header (events empty: read them by page).

data.description: Bytes of the chunk, standard base64 with padding.

last_seq.description: Last sequence returned (pass it as `after_seq` next time).

qemu.description: QEMU diagnostics of the current run (last lines, host paths removed).

oneOf.description: Response to the agent calls `declare` and `tool_note`.

seq.description: Report event recorded (0 if dropped by the limit).

oneOf.description: Response to `import_vmware`: the VM exists with its converted disk.

cancelled.description: `true` if an import was in progress and is being cancelled.

RevocationReport.description:
Report of a revocation or an Emergency Stop: distinguishes the discarded queue
from requests already forwarded (ROADMAP 7.3). It promises no cancellations.

already_forwarded.description: Operations already forwarded to the backend: they may have produced effects.

discarded.description: Queued operations discarded without forwarding (no effect).

Role.description:
Role associated with the channel credential.

`ui` corresponds to [`crate::Caller::User`] towards the core; `pairing` does not
grant permissions on VMs (ADR-0006): the agent session grant arrives
in F4 ([`crate::Grant`], [`crate::SessionToken`]).

oneOf.description: Desktop interface that started the service.
Client waiting for pairing (MCP adapter): no VM permissions.

RunId.description: RunId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

Screenshot.description:
Metadata of a screenshot produced by the backend (ROADMAP 6.4, 9). The image
bytes travel separately (MCP image content or IPC block),
never as a host path.

byte_len.description: Size in bytes of the image.

run_id.description: Run in which it was captured.

ServiceEvent.description: Events published on the state channel.

oneOf.description:
The baselines or the storage operation of a VM changed (operation
started or ended, baseline created, restored or deleted): re-read
`vm_status` and `list_baselines` (F3).
Events lost because the client was too slow.
A session request was decided, expired or withdrawn.
A session was created, paused, resumed or terminated.
The input owner of a VM changed.

A session report was created or changed (termination, verdict,
verification, deletion): re-read the list or the header (F5).

Progress of the VMware import in progress (ADR-0030); published at
most a few times per second. The end is the reply to
`import_vmware`.

SessionId.description: SessionId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

client_name.description: Client name declared by the agent (plain text).

connection_id.description: Agent connection the session is bound to (absent once terminated).

input_owner.description: `true` if the session owns the input of its VM.

purpose.description: Purpose declared by the agent (plain text).

SessionReport.description:
Canonical report of an agent session (`report.json`). In
`get_session_report` replies `events` is empty: events are read by page.

baseline_id.description:
Baseline the VM's current state was an overlay of at approval
(`None` = standalone disk).

client_name.description: Client name declared by the agent (plain text).

errors.description: Errors of agent calls and tools, by code.

objective.description: Objective (purpose declared by the agent and approved by the user).

report_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the canonical JSON with this field absent: detects
alterations, it is not a tamper-proof seal.

run_ids.description: Runs used, in order of first use.

screenshots_dropped.description: Screenshots not stored (retention limits): hash only.

verdicts.description: Verdicts in order (the last one is the current outcome).

vm_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the VM configuration at approval.

SessionReportSummary.description: Summary of a report, for lists.

SessionRequestInfo.description: Pending session request, for the UI.

client_name.description: Client name declared by the agent (plain text).

expires_at.description: The request expires at this instant if not decided.

peer_pid.description: Peer PID reported by the operating system, diagnostic only.

purpose.description: Purpose declared by the agent (plain text).

verification_code.description: Code shown to the agent and in the app.

SessionRequestOutcome.description: Outcome of a session request, in [`ServiceEvent::SessionRequestClosed`].

oneOf.description: Denied by the user (or by the agent access switch).
Agent pause: no new mutation forwarded; observation allowed.
Terminated (revocation, expiry, Emergency Stop, client loss...). Final.

SessionToken.description: Session secret, only on authenticated IPC; never in logs or reports.

StartPhase.description: Phase of a start before the VM process exists.

oneOf.description:
SHA-256 of the approved media (installation and data ISO) recomputed
through the protected handles (UI: "Verifying media…").

SHA-256 of the baseline the current state is an overlay of (base disk
and UEFI variables) recomputed through the guard handles (UI:
"Verifying baseline…").
Checks done: QEMU is being launched.

StartProgress.description: Progress of the checks of a start, in [`VmSummary::start`].

total_bytes.description: Bytes to hash in total (approved media plus baseline files).

verified_bytes.description: Bytes hashed so far, all files of the start together.

StopReason.description: Reason the agent sessions were stopped.

StorageOperation.description: Long storage operation in progress on a VM.

TerminationCause.description: Termination cause of a session (recorded in the report, ROADMAP 9).

oneOf.description: Lease not renewed within the limit.
Loss of the client or of the adapter.
VM failed or terminated during the session.
Baseline restore: the control session closes (ROADMAP 8).

TestOutcome.description:
Outcome of a test (ROADMAP 9). Completing the conversation does not
automatically produce `passed`.

oneOf.description: No reliable verifier or insufficient evidence.
Infrastructure failure, distinct from a model failure.

UtcTimestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z suffix, millisecond precision.

VcpuHalt.description:
Guest whose virtual CPUs stopped and were not restarted automatically, in
[`VmSummary::vcpu_halt`]. A reset (`reset`) restarts the guest; a forced
stop ends the run.

automatic_resets.description:
Automatic resets done in the recent window before the service gave up
(0 when the reason is not reset automatically).

oneOf.description:
Unrecoverable virtual CPU error reported by the accelerator (QEMU
run state `internal-error`; for example a guest triple fault under
WHPX, which real hardware would answer with a reset).
The guest reported a panic (QEMU run state `guest-panicked`).

Verdict.description: A verdict on the session, with its source and rationale.

VmBaselines.description: Baseline facts of a VM, in [`VmSummary`] (F3).

bytes.description:
Bytes used on the host by the baselines (disk images and UEFI
variables).

count.description: Number of baselines of the VM.

current.description:
Baseline the VM's current state is an overlay of (set by
`restore_baseline`); `None` = the VM runs on its standalone disk
(never restored).

operation.description: Storage operation in progress on the VM: the VM is busy until it ends.

overlay_bytes.description:
Bytes used on the host by the current overlay and its UEFI variables
(0 on the standalone disk).

VmConfig.description:
VM configuration requested by the user. No field is a path or
a QEMU option: media are referenced by [`MediaId`] of the approved registry.

data_media.description: Optional read-only data media (kind `data_iso`), attached with the VM off.

disk_gib.description: Virtual size of the main QCOW2 disk in GiB.

imported.description:
Hardware of a VM imported from VMware (ADR-0030), fixed at import:
disk controller, display adapter and CPU topology of the source VM.
`None` for every VM created in LightVM (the profile of ADR-0027
applies unchanged).

install_media.description: Installation media from the media registry (kind `install_iso`).

limits.description:
Execution limits applied by the supervisor to the QEMU process
(ADR-0017); missing in older catalogs → default values.

memory_mib.description: Guest memory in MiB (not the limit of the whole QEMU process).

network.description: Network profile; in the MVP only `offline`.

vcpus.description: Number of vCPUs (not a CPU percentage limit: ROADMAP 7.2).

VmId.description: VmId: version 7 UUID, lowercase with hyphens.

VmLimits.description:
Execution limits of a VM (ADR-0017), set by the user in the
VM settings and applied by the supervisor, never by the client.

cpu_max_percent.description:
CPU cap as a percentage of the capacity of the assigned vCPUs
([`MIN_CPU_MAX_PERCENT`]..=100; 100 = no cap). Applied by the
operating system to the whole QEMU process.

memory_margin_mib.description:
Memory granted to the QEMU process beyond the guest RAM, in MiB
([`MIN_MEMORY_MARGIN_MIB`]..=[`MAX_MEMORY_MARGIN_MIB`]). When the
limit is exceeded, QEMU is terminated and the exit is classified as a resource limit.

storage_budget_gib.description:
Maximum space in GiB for the VM's files beyond the main disk
(overlays, baselines, firmware variables); `None` = no dedicated budget.
Checked at every start.

VmName.description: VM name: ASCII label, not a path.

VmRecord.description: Catalog VM with configuration revision and last persisted state.

config_revision.description: Configuration revision, incremented on every change (revision check).

persisted_state.description: Last persisted state: a hint, the observed state takes precedence.

oneOf.description: Process absent and files released. The only state for operations on disks, NVRAM and media.
Spawn started, new `run_id` assigned, QMP not ready yet.
Stop requested; complete only once the process end is observed.
Start error or unexpected exit. No automatic promotion to baseline.
Reconciliation after a crash (journal, files, processes): no external mutation.

VmSummary.description: Summary of a VM for list and status.

baselines.description: Baselines and current state of the VM (F3).

config.description: Current configuration (resources and limits), for the VM settings.

config_revision.description: Configuration revision, to be given in `update_vm`.

disk_used_bytes.description:
Space occupied on the host by the VM's files (disk, firmware state),
if measurable.

run_id.description: Current run, if a process exists, or the last finished one.

start.description:
Sub-status of a start in progress (state `starting`): verification of
the approved media and of the baseline before QEMU is launched
(ADR-0008, ADR-0025). Absent outside a start, and for a start with
nothing to verify. Additive field: older clients ignore it.

state.description: Current state as seen by the core (derived from the process and QMP).

vcpu_halt.description:
The guest's virtual CPUs stopped on an error and stay stopped (state
`running`: the QEMU process is alive, the guest is not). Absent while
the guest runs. Additive field: older clients ignore it.

VmwareController.description: Disk controller of a VMware VM.

oneOf.description: SCSI, LSI Logic parallel (`lsilogic`): not emulated by QEMU.
SCSI, BusLogic (`buslogic`): not emulated by QEMU.

VmwareDiskPreview.description: Main disk of a VMware VM, in [`VmwareImportPreview`].

allocated_bytes.description: Bytes allocated by the files of the chain on the host.

file_name.description: File name of the current VMDK (top of the snapshot chain).

snapshot_levels.description: Snapshot levels flattened into the converted disk (0 = no snapshot).

vmware_controller.description: Controller of the disk in VMware.

VmwareImportPhase.description: Phase of a VMware import, in [`ServiceEvent::VmwareImportProgress`].

oneOf.description: Examination of the `.vmx` and of the disk chain.
Check of the converted disk and creation of the VM.

VmwareImportPreview.description:
Outcome of the examination of a VMware VM (ADR-0030), for the UI. The
texts come from the user's files: they are shown, never interpreted.
No path is included, only file names.

config.description:
Configuration the import would create; the name is a suggestion
from the VMware display name, the display the standard adapter.

display_name.description: `displayName` of the VMware VM, if present.

free_bytes.description: Free bytes on the catalog volume, if measured.

required_bytes.description:
Bytes needed on the catalog volume for the converted disk
(estimate: the data of the disk chain, at most its virtual size).

vmware_guest_os.description: VMware guest type as written in the `.vmx` (`guestOS`).

vmware_svga_offered.description: The VMware SVGA display adapter can be chosen (Windows guests).

vmware_tools_hint.description: The `.vmx` says the VMware Tools were installed in the guest (hint).

warnings.description: Warnings the user should read before importing.
